Short title and commencement

BANK OF PUNJAB (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
BANK OF PUNJAB (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1997
An Act further to amend the Bank
of Punjab Act, 1989
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 18th June, 1997]
No. Legis. 2(7)/97/82, dated 18‑6‑1997.‑‑The
Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Bill, 1997, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab on June 14, 1997 and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on June 16, 1997, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the Bank of Punjab
(Amendment) Act, 1997.
(2) It. shall come into force at
once

Amendment of section 4 of Act XII of 1989

BANK OF PUNJAB (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997
BANK OF PUNJAB (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1997
An Act further to amend the Bank
of Punjab Act, 1989
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 18th June, 1997]
No. Legis. 2(7)/97/82, dated 18‑6‑1997.‑‑The
Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Bill, 1997, having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab on June 14, 1997 and assented to by the Governor of the
Punjab on June 16, 1997, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab.
2. Amendment of section 4 of
Act XII of 1989.‑‑In the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 (XII of 1989)
in section 4, in subsection (1), for the words "five hundred million
rupees divided into fifty million ordinary shares", the words "one
thousand million rupees divided into one hundred million ordinary shares" shall
be substituted.

Repeal

BANK OF PUNJAB (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1997

3. Repeal.‑‑The
Bank of Punjab (Amendment) Ordinance (XVIII of 1997) is hereby repealed.
